== Kobold Gem of Flame Guard ==
[[File:Kobold Gem of Flame Guard orb.png|right|alt=Kobold Gem of Flame Guard, focus orb]]
[[File:Kobold Gem of Flame Guard.png|right|alt=Kobold Gem of Flame Guard, description]]
A gem empowered with the ability to grant a burning shield that damages attackers to all kobolds in a wide radius around the user.

Use this gem in a crystal collection [[challenge]] to give nearby [[Kobold Union Worker|kobold workers]] Buff Kobolds: Flame Guard.

Acquired by:
* {{Unverified|Killing monsters in the challenge, effectively [[Bound to Character]].}}
* Purchase from the [[DDOstore/Gear_and_Equipment#Challenge Tools|DDO Store]], [[Bound to Account]].
